"STORYVERSE AI — THE FUTURE OF STORYTELLING

Create a premium, futuristic AI entertainment application called STORYVERSE AI.

MAIN PURPOSE:

Build an application that allows users to photograph books, comics, documents, handwritten stories, recipes, newspapers, and other text-based materials and transform them into immersive cinematic audio storytelling experiences.

MAIN SCREEN:

- Beautiful black and deep-purple cinematic interface.
- Large glowing SCAN ANYTHING button.
- Camera upload and photo gallery options.
- Recently created experiences.
- Featured stories and genres.
- Premium, professional entertainment-app design.

CORE FEATURES:

1. AI SCANNER: Use the camera to photograph text and extract readable content using OCR.

2. CINEMATIC NARRATOR: Convert extracted text into natural, expressive narration.

3. MULTIPLE CHARACTERS: Identify dialogue and assign different realistic voices to individual characters.

4. CINEMATIC AUDIO: Generate appropriate background music, environmental sounds, dramatic effects, suspense, and emotional atmosphere.

5. GENRE SELECTOR: Horror, thriller, fantasy, science fiction, romance, comedy, mystery, and adventure.

6. VISUAL EXPERIENCE: Generate cinematic scene illustrations and optional animated scenes to accompany narration.

7. STORY LIBRARY: Save, organize, replay, and continue previous experiences.

8. VOICE CUSTOMIZATION: Allow users to select narration styles, character voices, accents, and playback speeds.

9. LANGUAGE SUPPORT: Support multiple languages and translation where available.

10. ORIGINAL STORY CREATOR: Allow users to write their own stories and transform them into cinematic productions.

IMPORTANT:

The application must have a functional interface, working navigation, camera/upload workflow, and realistic demonstrations of its features. Connect actual AI, OCR, text-to-speech, and audio-generation services where supported. Do not present simulated features as fully functional.

Respect copyright: support public-domain works, licensed content, original writing, and content users are authorized to process.

BUSINESS MODEL:

- Free introductory tier.
- Premium monthly subscription.
- Unlimited or expanded cinematic experiences on higher tiers.
- Premium character voices.
- Premium visual storytelling.
- Creator tools.

DESIGN GOAL:

Make STORYVERSE AI look and feel like a billion-dollar entertainment technology company. It should look polished, futuristic, cinematic, addictive to explore, and simple enough for anyone to use.

TAGLINE: DON'T JUST READ IT. EXPERIENCE IT.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build and verify a polished STORYVERSE AI storytelling app with navigation, story creation and library, image/text import, OCR, and narration.

## Requirements
- Cinematic black/deep-purple design, responsive layout, and tagline “DON'T JUST READ IT. EXPERIENCE IT.”
- Support authorized content, public-domain works, and original writing; clearly disclose simulated or unavailable AI features.
- Include camera/photo upload, OCR, narration, genres, story library, creator options, and business-model presentation.
- Verify with a small JPEG screenshot and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript app without a backend.
- Narration and soundscape use browser-native/local capabilities; AI narration, generation, character voices, cloud storage, and billing are not connected.
- OCR uses Tesseract.js from jsDelivr on demand; text-file imports work locally.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built responsive home, library, story detail, and story creator screens with sample stories and genre navigation.
- Implemented localStorage story persistence, text import, image upload with browser OCR UI, camera capture UI, browser speech synthesis, synthesized ambient tones, and feature-limit disclosures.
- `node --check app.js` passed.
- Browser-tested navigation, story creation/save, library search, and text-file import.
- Added an inline SVG favicon to `index.html`.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/storyverse.jpg`.

### Active
- Continue browser QA: verify OCR extraction, confirm favicon change clears the console 404, and investigate narration startup failure.
- Clean up the QA-created “QA Sample Story” from browser localStorage if it should not remain in the demo data.

### Blocked
- Browser narration attempt failed with “Narration could not start. Try another browser voice.”
- Camera testing is blocked by the browser environment reporting “Requested device not found”; the UI provides an upload alternative.

## Next Move
1. Reload the app and check whether the favicon 404 is resolved.
2. Investigate browser speech synthesis failure and retest narration where a device voice is available.
3. Run OCR extraction on an image and check its result; camera capture cannot be verified without a camera device.
4. Remove QA test data from localStorage if appropriate, then rerun relevant checks.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: App structure and inline SVG favicon.
- `styles.css`: Responsive cinematic styling.
- `app.js`: Navigation, story persistence, OCR, camera, narration, soundscape, and interactions.
- `screenshots/storyverse.jpg`: Captured homepage screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- App is served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser QA created “QA Sample Story” and browser localStorage now contains four stories; a text import test also populated the creator form.
- Browser console previously showed a favicon 404; the favicon link was added afterward but has not yet been verified after reload.
- No connected AI generation, character voice assignment, subscription, or billing.
